acceptance.given: The subprocess capability implementation and its unit-test selector are available for inspection.

oracle.expected: The unit verification inspects the capability definition and finds cwd represented as an explicit declared field or parameter.
forbidden: The inspected subprocess capability has no cwd declaration.
oracle.observable: Unit-test inspection of the subprocess capability declaration records an explicit cwd field or parameter.

acceptance.then: The subprocess capability exposes cwd as a declared contract field or parameter.
acceptance.when: During unit verification, run the targeted native process ownership test selector and inspect the implementation declaration used by the test.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the targeted selector in scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_replay_process_regressions.py with an assertion that the subprocess capability declaration exposes cwd; the selector must fail when cwd is absent.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the subprocess capability contract explicitly declare cwd and verify that declaration at the native process boundary.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert the cwd declaration enforcement and its focused assertion; no persisted state or schema migration is changed.

slice_hint.state_transition: The subprocess capability moves from an implementation whose cwd declaration is not verified to one exposing and verifying cwd as an explicit declaration.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The focused native process unit selector observes the explicit cwd declaration and passes its contract assertion.
